user.title: Connect to multi-scrobbler
user.description: Point this at a multi-scrobbler ListenBrainz endpoint. With the standard endpoint, enter the server URL only, for example `http://192.168.1.23:9078`.

data_description.url: Base URL, for example http://192.168.1.23:9078. A full .../1/submit-listens or .../api/listenbrainz/<slug> URL also works.
data_description.token: The token configured on the multi-scrobbler ListenBrainz endpoint. It is sent as 'Authorization: Token YOUR_TOKEN'.

data_description.players: Tick the Music Assistant or Sonos players you actually listen on. Pick one entity per physical speaker.
data_description.scrobble_percent: Percentage of a track with a known duration that must play before it is scrobbled. Four minutes is used as an upper limit.
data_description.radio_min_seconds: Radio tracks have no reliable duration, so they are scrobbled after this many seconds of playback.
data_description.now_playing: Send a 'playing now' update when a track starts. This is separate from a scrobble.
data_description.strip_year: When the source is radio, remove a trailing (89) or (1989) from the title, for example 'Lonely (89)' becomes 'Lonely'.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.
error.no_players: Select at least one media player.

abort.already_configured: This server and token are already configured.
